details:
- rebase onto Oracle 1.10.4-2.0.7.el7_9
- the vendor fixes in this build: CVE-2026-18295 and CVE-2026-18296
  (qtmoovrecover: validate box sizes), CVE-2026-18298 (gdkpixbufdec: handle
  format and resolution changes correctly) and CVE-2026-18299 (rtpsbcdepay:
  check that enough data is available in the adapter)
- keep the TuxCare wavpackdec follow-up to the vendor's Patch1007: it widens the
  output-buffer size computation in gst_wavpack_dec_handle_frame() to gsize,
  which the vendor's backport leaves in 32-bit arithmetic on this branch
- keep the matroska-demux.c correction that restores the 18-byte WAVEFORMATEX
  offset dropped by the vendor's Patch1003 in its pre-2.67.4 glib port
- keep the gtk-doc build fix and BuildRequires: gtk-doc unbounded rather than
  Oracle's <= 1.25.1, which no i686 buildroot can satisfy
- renumber the two TuxCare follow-up patches to Patch1011 and Patch1012; Oracle
  took 1008 and 1009 for its own patches in this build
- keep the CVE-2026-73433 and CVE-2026-73434 avidemux fixes from
  1.10.4-2.0.5.tuxcare.els2, renumbered to Patch1013 and Patch1014 since
  Oracle took 1010 in this build
